svg.title: 04 · The hype curve: quiet far from anything, loudest while it is live
svg.text: 04 · The hype curve: quiet far from anything, loudest while it is live
Main hall at 1080p in Demo night, at low and high hype, and the curve that drives them.

g.text: Semi-finals start at 19:40 on the main stage · Pizza order open until 18:30 · Quiz at 21:15

svg.text: A · 18:10, far from anything: hype low
Calm: a quiet stage, slow drift; the coming semi-finals are a small tile in the rail.

g.text: The final is live on the main stage · Aurora 1 – 1 Nova

svg.text: B · 22:40, the final is live: hype at its top
Party, the ceiling: the story owns the hero; the game's art, dense particles, the score's glow.
The hype curve of the Main hall, 17:00 to midnight: it builds over the hour before a big item, holds while it is live, and falls after
party above this line (if the zone's level allows it)
the game's art over a busy look
plus pop and the ring burst
a small tile in the rail
party: the zone's level, the ceiling
The level follows the hype up to the zone's level, its ceiling; quiet hours cap it at calm, and a change waits for the next turn, at most once in 5 min. The pace never changes (amendment 1).
